posts.title: Happy π Approximation Day!
posts.description: Join me today on 22 July (22/7) as we celebrate Π\Pi Approximation Day! posts.title: A perfect day
posts.description: Yesterday was 28 June and it’s time to announce once again that it was a perfect day. posts.title: Seeing Sums: Diagrams are more than Decorations
posts.description: I am turning 32 this year. It’s been five long years since I last posted here.
